entities.name: K'rrik
entities.description: A Phyrexian sleeper agent on Tolaria, initially known as Kerrick, who later renamed himself K'rrik and became lord of a Phyrexian fortress in a fast-time rift.

entities.name: Tolaria
entities.description: The Dominarian island with the Academy where Kerrick crashed and where the Phyrexian attack and temporal disaster occurred.

entities.name: Jhoira
entities.description: A young student at the Academy who rescued Kerrick, fell in love with him, and was killed in the Phyrexian attack.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: The silver golem and Jhoira's only true friend who discovers Kerrick's sabotage and fights the negators.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: A planeswalker who ran the time-traveling experiments, petrified some students and later fought K'rrik.

entities.name: Barrin
entities.description: A teacher at the Academy who was killed in the attack and later petrified; his forces were overrun in the Invasion of Tolaria.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A magical prodigy at the Academy with a crush on Jhoira who was killed in the attack.

entities.name: Phyrexian negators
entities.description: Phyrexian creatures Kerrick brought into the Academy and later bred in great numbers.

entities.name: Multani
entities.description: A Yavimaya elemental who imprisoned Urza and later helped him kill K'rrik.

entities.name: Yavimaya
entities.description: The place where Multani imprisoned Urza.

entities.name: Shiv
entities.description: The place Jhoira dreamed of and to which Urza went to gather warriors.

entities.name: Time machine
entities.description: Urza's time-traveling device that overloaded and exploded, causing the temporal disaster.

entities.name: Fast-time rift
entities.description: A rift in which time runs fast, where K'rrik built his Phyrexian fortress and army.

entities.name: Invasion of Tolaria
entities.description: The Phyrexian assault in which Barrin's forces were overrun.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: The home of the Phyrexians that Urza glimpsed in the chasm.

events.summary: Kerrick crashes on the Tolarian beach and is rescued by the young Jhoira, who falls in love with him and hides him in a cave.
events.quote: Kerrick crashed on the Tolarian beach with his ship and was found and rescued by a young Jhoira

events.summary: Karn, sent back in time by Urza's experiment, finds Kerrick and Jhoira and promises to tell no one.
events.quote: Karn discovered Kerrick and Jhoira but promised to tell no one about them.

events.summary: Karn sees Kerrick stealing blueprints from Urza's lab and follows him to a secret Phyrexian meeting where he overhears the invasion plans.
events.quote: Karn overheard the Phyrexian's plans to invade the Academy

events.summary: Kerrick brings negators into the Academy, and they slaughter students and teachers, including Jhoira.
events.quote: Kerrick had brought Phyrexian negators into the Academy.

events.summary: Karn finds Jhoira's corpse and slays her killer, a negator; Urza tells him Barrin and Teferi are dead too and sends him back in time.
events.quote: Karn then fought and slew Jhoira's killer, a Phyrexian negator.

events.summary: The time machine overloads and explodes, causing the great temporal disaster; Urza petrifies nearby students and staff and planeswalks away.
events.quote: Then the machine exploded and caused the great temporal disaster in Tolaria.

events.summary: Kerrick survives in a fast-time rift, builds a Phyrexian fortress and army, and renames himself K'rrik, lord of the fortress.
events.quote: he renamed himself K'rrik and became the lord of that fortress

events.summary: Barrin's forces are overrun in the Invasion of Tolaria while Multani holds Urza prisoner in Yavimaya.
events.quote: Barrin's forces were finally overrun in the Invasion of Tolaria

events.summary: Urza descends into the fast-time chasm and sees the horrors of Phyrexia; K'rrik disables him.
events.quote: Urza descended into the fast-time chasm and saw the horrors of Phyrexia

events.summary: Multani lends Urza his strength and together they kill K'rrik; Multani animates Tolaria's forests to destroy the remaining negators.
events.quote: Multani lent Urza his strength and killed the Phyrexian together

relations.note: fell in love with Kerrick, unaware he was an agent
relations.quote: She fell in love with Kerrick
was a Phyrexian sleeper agent on the Dominarian island of Tolaria

relations.note: lord of the fortress who raised generations of negators
relations.quote: He was able to spawn generations of Phyrexian Negators in one year
Multani lent Urza his strength and killed the Phyrexian together

relations.note: imprisoned him in Yavimaya before allying with him
relations.quote: While Urza was imprisoned in Yavimaya by Multani

relations.note: saw Urza protect Tolaria's life and lent him strength
relations.quote: Multani observed that Urza protected all the life in Tolaria from the Phyrexians
